summary: The company will design a remote control for TV control targeting 15-35 year olds. Key requirements include a unique, fashionable design with corporate color and slogan 'Putting the fashion in electronics'. Basic functions will include volume, channel, and skip. The design will aim to be easy to use and high-tech. Tele-text functionality will be excluded due to internet popularity. The remote will only control the TV, not other devices.
